content.short: Cosmofox is a space-themed NFT gaming project on TON featuring exploration and Play-to-Earn rewards.
content.description: Cosmofox is a space-themed decentralized gaming and NFT project built on The Open Network. It invites players to explore a virtual galaxy using their unique 'Cosmofox' NFT characters, which serve as their digital identity and utility in the game's universe. The project emphasizes exploration, resource management, and social interaction, all backed by the security and transparency of the TON blockchain. Cosmofox provides an engaging and visually distinct Play-to-Earn experience for users who are passionate about space adventure and digital collectibles.
content.meta: Explore the galaxy and earn with Cosmofox on TON. Space-themed NFT gaming on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
